correctness.rationale: Exact weighted matrix-tree identity gives conditional independent multinomials and the shifted binomial degree law. The normalized bipartite tree count gives the class-size pmf. Adjacent conditional mass ratios decrease strictly in class size and supports nest, implying strict reversed likelihood-ratio ordering; elementary covariance identity implies strict negative regression. Conditional Poisson limit follows from binomial rare-events convergence. Exactly 340 independent arithmetic assertions passed on all labeled trees through n=7 and fixed bipartition counts; finite checks support but do not replace the algebraic proof.
